NO TECH BACKGROUND NEEDED

Four terms, in everyday language.

API

An app’s doorway for software. It lets an AI assistant do specific jobs, such as finding a customer or reading a support ticket.

Authentication

How the app checks who is asking. This might be signing in and giving permission, or providing a secret access key.

MCP

A shared way for AI assistants to use tools. Think of it as a common connector. It does not remove an app’s access restrictions.

SDK

A ready-made set of building blocks for developers. We added Composio’s SDK to set up the research tools instead of building that connection from scratch.

HOW THE RESEARCH WORKS

Find the instructions.
Check the answer. Keep the proof.

Find

AI researchers look for each app’s official developer instructions. The original 100-app study used web research tools.

Record

They write down how to sign in, whether payment or approval is needed, and which jobs software can perform.

Double-check

A separate AI review revisits selected answers. Source links and saved research let another person check the same claims.

Refresh with Composio

The added workflow uses Composio’s SDK to set up a session and MCP to read official documentation in its hosted research workspace. Its actual run status appears below.

Try the Composio research workflow

Recheck five apps using Composio’s web tools. This gathers new evidence; it does not silently change the published findings.

Checking whether the research tools are ready…

Developer setup and commands

Add your Composio project key to the local .env file. A key is required even though these research tools do not need individual vendor accounts.

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/research.py --transport composio --limit 5
python scripts/research.py --transport composio --limit 100

Composio handles session setup and the tool connection. MCP carries the search and page-reading requests. Optional AI extraction needs a separate model API key.

What has actually been tested?

The original study did not use Composio. The new Composio workflow is an addition; the status box shows whether it has completed a real run.

A person still needs to check uncertain app identities, confirm account requirements, and try signing in. We have not tested real operations inside all 100 apps.

HOW MUCH SHOULD YOU TRUST THIS?

The limits are here, too.

The 10 follow-up checks focused on answers most likely to be wrong. They were done by AI, not a person. That is useful evidence, but it cannot tell us the accuracy of the entire list.

Human-checked accuracy: not measured yet. A page loading successfully also does not prove that our answer is correct.
